verdict.rationale: The official quickstart walks a developer from console.x.ai signup and API key creation to a runnable first request in curl, Python, and JavaScript in the same guide, with no sales contact needed. OpenAI REST compatibility also lets existing OpenAI client code work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the first call takes only minutes, runnable quickstart samples beyond curl/Python/JavaScript, and no evidence on how much friction the required credit-loading step adds before the first call.
